Identified as this saint because: Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), October volume, plate for the 8th. 8 October is Pelagia the Penitent of Antioch, the one-time harlot converted by the preaching of bishop Nonnus as told by the deacon James - which is precisely the folder's life, and the folder types her 'venerable', not 'martyr'. Her namesake Pelagia of Tarsus falls on 4 May and has her own plate (09041) in the same series, which is used for the other folder; the two are kept apart here by the volume's month and the plate's day.
